name: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad (2017)
owner: Gobierno de México — Presidencia de la República
description: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad (published November 13, 2017). Mexico's national cybersecurity strategy published by the Federal Government in November 2017 across five strategic objectives (society and rights, economy and innovation, public institutions, critical infrastructure, and national security) and eight cross-cutting pillars.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Gobierno de México — Presidencia de la República (gob.mx) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Gobierno de México — Presidencia de la República (gob.mx).
